assertions.assertion: Program.cs removes or replaces at least one static AddOpenIdConnect registration with dynamic provider configuration
assertions.rationale: Replaces static AddOpenIdConnect with AddConfigurationStore-based dynamic providers; instructs removing static registrations.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs or a seed file creates an OidcProvider with Scheme set to 'demoidsrv' and Authority set to 'https://demo.duendesoftware.com'
Program.cs calls AddConfigurationStoreCache() for caching dynamic provider lookups
Response mentions or acknowledges that dynamic identity providers require the Enterprise Edition
assertions.rationale: States dynamic providers are Enterprise edition.
